title: GoHotpathPipelineOutput
description: Output schema for the go-anything go hot-path end-to-end porting pipeline.

function.description: Hot-path function name selected for porting.

unit_state.description: Current lifecycle state of the unit (e.g. 'Planned', 'Ready', 'In progress', 'Verified', 'Shadow').

current_step.description: The active or last executed pipeline step name.

steps.description: Ordered record of pipeline step results.

summary.description: Summary description of the step outcome.

artifacts.description: List of artifacts or reports produced by this step.

human_action_required.description: Exact human CLI command required when human gate is reached (e.g. 'go-anything approve --unit <unit>').

timestamp.description: UTC timestamp of the pipeline run.
